poc_sharing.error_status.developer_comment: POC-only: plain interpolation mirror of apps/forms errorNotProblem.status.

poc_sharing.session_timeout.string: Please log in <loginLink>here</loginLink> in a different browser tab and try again.
poc_sharing.session_timeout.developer_comment: POC-only: sentence with an inline tag placeholder that resolves to an anchor. Mirrors apps/forms sessionTimeoutModal.body.

poc_sharing.error_modal.body.string: Your data was not submitted. Error message: <errorBox>{errorMessage}</errorBox> You can close this dialog and try again. If the error keeps happening, please contact the person who asked you to fill this Form or <supportEmail>support@getodk.org</supportEmail>.
poc_sharing.error_modal.body.developer_comment: POC-only: sentence with two inline tag placeholders. The <errorBox> tag wraps a primitive {errorMessage} whose value comes from the caller. Mirrors apps/forms errorModal.body — the dynamic error text is inside a rendered element.
